name: Devin Jeong
life: “I still remember scrubbing through an old ship name by mistake.” On Thursday, near the window at Night Shift Donuts, Devin knows when the going-home crowd and the coming-to-work crowd will both be there.
voice: I thought the bird was a stain and scrubbed one wing away. I found the original painter to help me fix it.
appearance: Devin has a broad nose and a deep dimple on one cheek. Look for a center part and straight chestnut hair. Back on the street, the familiar outfit is a faded indigo overshirt with a printed handkerchief folded into the pocket. In conversation Devin squares up pieces of paper while thinking.
personality: Devin enjoys bargaining, including over things already settled. It is partly a joke and partly a test of whether the other person feels able to say no.
agenda: To restore the wing with the original painter.
family: Pia Mercerly is Devin’s cousin. Devin brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. Pia makes room at the table. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *Two portions*, Pia says, “The man gives me his late partner's recipes and corrects every batch.”
connections: Logan Hamm. A break granted to the watcher lets the painter mend the scrubbed wing.
